quests.name: Broodling Essence
quests.objective: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.objective: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
quests.objective: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
quests.description: Using the module on the eggs in the Rookery can hatch whelps.

quests.name: Seal of Ascension
quests.objective: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake Emberstrife and beat him until his will is broken, place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before him, then use the Orb of Draconic Energy on him and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension.
quests.description: Take the Unforged Seal and the Orb of Draconic Energy to Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. The forged seal opens the UBRS door.

quests.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
quests.objective: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
quests.description:
Doomrigger's Coffer is in the Rookery. Then take Delivery to Ridgewell to Count Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind Keep for the reward.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Mayara Brightwing
quests.objective: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to Doomrigger's Clasp.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: The Darkstone Tablet
quests.objective: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
quests.description:
The Darkstone Tablet lies on the ground in the Rookery.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
quests.objective: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to The Darkstone Tablet.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring
quests.objective: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
quests.objective: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.objective: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Tinkee Steamboil
quests.objective: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

quests.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
quests.objective: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall. You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

quests.name: For The Horde!
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Finkle Einhorn, At Your Service!
quests.objective: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
quests.description: He appears from The Beast's corpse after the fight. Malyfous then offers the Pristine Hide of the Beast exchanges.

start.description: From The Beast's corpse, Upper Blackrock Spire

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
quests.description: Kill General Drakkisath at the end of UBRS.

quests.name: The Demon Forge
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire, slay Goraluk Anvilcrack and use the Blood Stained Pike on his corpse. Also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return the Soul Stained Pike and the breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
quests.description: Blacksmithing 270 (Armorsmith). Use the Blood Stained Pike on Goraluk's corpse and loot the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate nearby.

quests.name: The Matron Protectorate
quests.objective: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
quests.description: Awbee is the wounded blue dragon near the arena route after Rend. Use the rune deep in the Mazthoril cave to reach Haleh.

quests.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
quests.objective: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

quests.name: The Great Masquerade
quests.objective: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

quests.name: The Dragon's Eye
quests.objective: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
quests.objective: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

quests.name: What the Wind Carries
quests.objective: Listen to Thrall.

quests.name: The Champion of the Horde
quests.objective: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

quests.name: The Testament of Rexxar
quests.objective: Deliver Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Oculus Illusions
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
quests.description: Part of the Horde Onyxia chain. Black Dragonspawn Eyes drop from the dragonspawn in UBRS.

quests.name: Emberstrife
quests.objective: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
quests.objective: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife. You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
quests.objective: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
quests.objective: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
quests.objective: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

quests.name: Ascension...
quests.objective: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

quests.name: Blackhand's Command
quests.objective: Find the brand that General Drakkisath guards and gain the Mark of Drakkisath, so you can use the Orb of Command.
quests.description: The Scarshield Quartermaster is in the hallway outside the Spire portal. Touch Drakkisath's Brand behind General Drakkisath; this unlocks the Orb of Command shortcut to Blackwing Lair.

start.description: Blackhand's Command (letter from the Scarshield Quartermaster, Blackrock Mountain)
